newsitem.title: USA: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. sorghum weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA sorghum export sales highlights in latest report week:

Sales of 35,400 MT were up 26 percent from the previous week, but down one-third from the 4-week average. Israel (22,000 MT), Mexico (8,000 MT, reflects 37,300 new sales and 29,300 cancellations), and Japan (5,400 MT) were the buyers.
Exports of 87,300 MT were up 9 percent from the prior week, but down 22 percent from the 4-week average. Mexico (59,500 MT) and Japan (27,800 MT) were the destinations.
